_README: Per-test wall-clock time budgets for the coop suite, in seconds. Read verbatim
by BOTH runners: tools/ci/run_coop_suite.ps1 (the CI shard runner) and
tools/coop_test/run_parallel.py (the local K-lane runner). This file is the
single source of truth -- keep the two parsers agreeing by editing only here.
* Every test gets default_budget_s unless it is listed under 'exceptions'.
* A test that FINISHES over its budget FAILS the suite even if it passed
('BUDGET EXCEEDED') -- re-engineer the test or add a justified exception.
* A test still running at hard_kill_multiplier x its budget is killed (with
the game subtree it spawned) and failed ('BUDGET HARD-KILL'), so a hung
test can never wedge a shard now that the CI step wall-clock timeout is gone.
* No exception may exceed max_budget_s. There are no unlimited budgets; the
runners hard-error on load if an exception is over the cap.
Each exception carries the observed CI duration in its 'reason'. Seeded from CI
run 31999655291 (4 shard jobs 95300140003/032/045/091) and last green main run
Give exceptions headroom: CI runners are slower and contended vs local.

test_coop_debrief_sync.reason: CI 529.8s (run 31999655291, shard 2) -- heaviest test; full both-machine debrief handshake. Not in test_weights.json (new), so the shard planner under-weighted it and its shard hit the 25min wall.

test_parallel_soak.reason: CI 305.8s (run 31999655291, shard 4, retried) -- long multi-turn parallel soak by design. Local weight 345s.

test_parallel_endturn.reason: CI 135.7s (run 31999655291, shard 4) but local weight 420s (highest in test_weights.json) -- end-turn readiness/reserve matrix. Provisioned above the local weight so a slow run can't spuriously hard-kill it.

test_parallel_intents.reason: CI 170.1s (run 31999655291, shard 2, retried) -- near the 180s default; local weight 300s. Intent round-trip matrix; would breach the default on a slower/contended runner.

test_parallel_skip.reason: CI 157.8s (run 31999655291, shard 3) -- near the 180s default; local weight 300s. Skip/fast-forward flow matrix.

test_coop_outcome_gaps.reason: CI 183.2s (run 31999655291, shard 3) -- over the 180s default; local weight 230s. AUDIT-rng GAP battery (spawns/psi/melee/pellets/ignite/panic/proximity).

test_parallel_speed_skew.reason: CI 31.0s (run 31999655291, shard 1) but local weight 240s -- deliberately paces two game clocks against each other (pinned to the serial lane locally). Provisioned to the local weight.

test_sync_check.reason: CI 222.9s single attempt (run 32062804444, shard 2); ~207s local contended. Full ten-bucket sync-check scenario battery. Tracked for re-engineering under issue #169.
